CheckTitle: Pages project preview deployments should be disabled or restricted
Description: Checks that Cloudflare Pages projects have preview deployments disabled. When enabled, every branch push creates a publicly accessible *.pages.dev URL that can expose development work, staging secrets, or internal tools.
Risk: Unrestricted preview deployments can expose sensitive features, environment variables, or internal APIs before they are hardened for production. The preview URLs are publicly accessible by default with no authentication.

Code.Other: Cloudflare Dashboard > Pages > [project] > Settings > Builds & deployments > Preview deployments > Disable

Recommendation.Text: Disable preview deployments for production Pages projects, or restrict them to specific branches only (e.g. only 'staging' branch). Use Cloudflare Access to password-protect any preview URLs that must remain enabled.

Notes: If preview deployments are needed for a staging workflow, consider protecting them with Cloudflare Access policies.
